newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down, seen mixed.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down, seen mixed.

text.p: Pakistani stocks slipped lower on Sunday amid weak sentiment and lack of support from major investors, dealers said.
They said political and economic uncertainty before general elections set for February 3 might keep the market mixed as major players remained cautious.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 9.07 points, or 0.66 percent, to end at 1,369.50. Losers led gainers 169 to 60. Turnover fell to 21.77 million shares from 24.19 million in the previous session on Thursday.
